observations.classification: New bounded source observation; central owner must reconcile exact prior finding aliases and count.
observations.source_reasoning: For an enabled fork, ROOT_FORK_SIDE chooses the sign and OAK_ROOT_FORK_ANGLE contributes a random magnitude 0.5..0.85 to OakRootFork.angle_offset. The only inspected production consumer takes angle_offset.signum() and combines fixed horizontal/lateral weights 0.76/0.42 before normalization. For fixed parent tangent and side, changing only the generated magnitude cannot change that direction; attachment, reach, parent profile and other draws still vary. Git filename-only search for angle_offset within tree geometry returned skeleton.rs, root_plan.rs and root_profile.rs; skeleton declaration was personally read, but this bounded search is not a whole-repository verdict. Same source pattern exists in old assigned objects.
observations.impact_and_limits: The field and RNG purpose imply an angular magnitude, but whether a variable fork angle is intended is a policy question, not a demonstrated rendered artifact. No generated seed witness, graphics, test, numeric probe, feature or platform validation. Bounded searches of 059 queue/ledger and selected 774 rig records found no exact angle_offset hit; this is not global absence or alias proof.
observations.possible_future_direction: If variable magnitude is intended, carry its semantic angle into the fork direction with the actual finite/unit policy; if only a side is intended, represent the side directly and reconcile the obsolete magnitude draw and deterministic replay policy. Central ledger decides scope after source-owner comparison; no implementation now.

observations.classification: Existing 059 q607 and 774 rig root-plan obligation, partly narrowed source evidence; no unique new count.
observations.source_reasoning: Current oak constants choose 4–5 roots and 2–3 dominant entries if the bounded index sampler honors its inspected documented [0, upper) contract; the used-index mask therefore has an unselected root for every dominant iteration. Inclusive high-24-bit scaling produces finite values in [0,1]; initial gap weights lie in [0.62,1.44]. In exact real arithmetic for up to five roots the minimum initial gap exceeds 0.6 rad, wider than 2 × 0.22 rad. Zero root_count makes the output loop empty; it does not itself execute division.
observations.limits: The next/previous clamp is updated sequentially in f32; this bound alone does not certify floating rounding, every later intermediate separation, native sample_below behavior or all seeds. A clamp bounds inversion, supported panic, or numerical run is not asserted.

observations.classification: Connected 059 q607 and historical ADDITIONAL-046 to F034/F035; exact aliases unresolved, no new count.
observations.source_reasoning: The actual fork helper samples the second polyline segment and projects its tangent to XZ before normalize; retained TreeBranchSegment stores raw vectors and radii. Raw presentation-scope gnarling f32 inputs flow through clamp and source-site addition, while the canonical seeded producer and authored natural preset have narrower intended shapes.
observations.limits: An arbitrary malformed, nonfinite or zero tangent is not automatically an admitted supported tree. Whether generated fork parameters can make a zero or nonfinite horizontal tangent, actual mesh/native behavior, supported recipe inputs and exact F034/F035 relation remain open. No runtime/probe or observed incident.
